sn37.23:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. katamehi pañcahi: saddho ca hoti, hirimā ca hoti, ottāpī ca hoti, upaṭṭhitasati ca hoti, paññavā ca hoti.
sn37.23:1.2: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti.
